hypotheses.M1_all_attention_replacement_removal_blo: Replacing all twelve changed-run attention writes by base-run writes makes final logits agree with the native base run to maximum absolute error at most 1e-4.
hypotheses.M2_all_attention_insertion_recovers_most: Replacing all twelve base-run attention writes by changed-run writes reaches Fisher fidelity at least 0.50 on every corpus and edit position.
hypotheses.M3_top4_captures_most_available_insertio: Top-four replacement insertion fidelity is at least 75% of all-layer replacement insertion fidelity on every corpus and edit position.
hypotheses.M4_routing_is_distributed_beyond_one_lay: All-layer replacement insertion fidelity exceeds top-one fidelity by at least 0.20 on every corpus and edit position.
hypotheses.M5_middle_layers_are_the_main_phase: Middle-layer replacement insertion fidelity exceeds both early- and late-layer fidelity on every corpus and edit position.
hypotheses.M6_replacement_and_delta_interventions_a: For every route, corpus, and edit position, replacement and additive-delta insertion fidelities differ by at most 0.20.
hypotheses.M7_topk_frontier_is_monotone: Replacement insertion fidelity is nondecreasing across top-1, top-2, top-4, top-8, and all-layer routes on every corpus and edit position.
hypotheses.M8_all_attention_is_structurally_necessa: All-layer removal blocks at least 99% of target Fisher projection, while no top-one replacement insertion reaches 0.50 fidelity, on every corpus and edit position.
